title: Create your business
subtitle: Set up your business to get started. You can add more businesses later.

tour.welcome: Welcome to rtylr! Let me show you around your command center.
tour.dashboard: This is your home. Search anything, launch apps, and pick up where you left off.
tour.team: Manage your team here. Add members, assign roles, and control which apps they can access.
tour.apps: All your apps live here. POS, ERP, HR, CRM, Finance, and Flow. Click any app to launch it.
tour.caret: Meet Caret, your AI assistant. Ask it anything about your business data.
tour.settings: Account settings, billing, and integrations are all here.
